ValidationRule.description:
The validation rule will not trigger on Enterprise Opportunities. The code listed below here will trigger on ALL Opporutnity Rec Types.
AND(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Up-Sell/Lift"),ISNULL(IM_Up_Sell_Quantity__c ))
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Up-Sell/Lift"), ISNULL( IM_Up_Sell_Quantity__c ), NOT( RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDec"), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Type is Up-Sell you must fill in the Up-Sell Quantity
